question: When histories can come from other makers, does inferring persistence preserve useful personal evidence without treating unrelated histories as personal evidence?
scope: Supplied-law native information ruler in original and widened law regimes, with context-current evidence and four complete past episodes. Learned contamination detection remains a separate conditional successor.
population: Eight development coefficient worlds, 256 current cases each. No fitted seeds: these are exact conditional calculations, not repeated fitted replications.
sampling: Current cases follow each world law. Historical contexts are randomized independently of current maker and held identical across all conditions. At each episode, sample the current maker with the registered persistence probability, otherwise an independent uniform maker; sample an episode conditional on that maker and matched context. Uniform draws couple the conditions. A coincidentally identical independently sampled maker is not a same-source assignment.
shuffled_author_control: A complete history bundle comes from one independently sampled foreign maker, with the same contexts. Its within-bundle dependence is deliberately outside the independent-contamination mixture; the zero-persistence calculation in that condition is a diagnostic misspecification, not an exact oracle.
inferred_mixture: Uniform prior over the four registered persistence rates, shared across four episodes within each case; integrate unnormalized joint masses before normalization. Infer using current observations and history, without current target labels.
privileges: All arms know the generator law, maker-state vocabulary and conditional episode probabilities. This is not a learned architecture comparison or law-marginal information ceiling. Exact-law headroom and direct convergence are not inherited into a superiority screen.
contradiction_policy: A rigid model can assign zero likelihood to the combined evidence. Preserve the contradiction indicator and fraction, then use the current-only posterior as an explicit decision fallback. Do not describe that fallback as the rigid model's conditional posterior.
known_answer_controls: Unrelated independent histories leave the exact current-only posterior unchanged
Identical maker emission distributions eliminate the persistence effect
Current joint and conditional historical masses independently regroup from elementary rows
Separate probability-domain reference checks every prediction
Full frozen scientific original-law replay before acceptance
stopping: Land each finite diagnostic once. Do not scale up personalization from this supplied-law ruler. Continue learned persistence only if separately implemented, independently validated and resource-admitted; no repeated valid world cells.
repair: One bounded pre-admission repair records impossible rigid-model evidence and its declared fallback. Failed source and CPU remain retained. No second family repair is available.
limitations: Supplied law and finite maker identities are evaluator privileges
Randomized matched contexts differ from the natural history distribution
No direct-reader convergence or capacity comparison
No execution shift or native-to-shift contrast
The finite diagnostic does not exhaust learned B03 scope
